summary: Comprehensive testing of updated Petal & Paw ecommerce website with new features - all major functionalities working perfectly including letterbox products, product search, monthly subscriptions with pet toy addon, step-based bouquet builder, delivery date picker, referral system, and admin dashboard with order management

minor_issues.issue: Subscription plans have initial loading delay, require page refresh to load consistently

passed_tests: GET /api/products returns 10 products with letterbox category (3 products)
GET /api/products?category=letterbox returns 3 letterbox flowers correctly
GET /api/products/search?q=rose returns 2 search results
GET /api/products/search?q=letterbox returns 3 letterbox products
GET /api/subscriptions/plans returns 3 monthly-only plans with pet toy option
GET /api/bouquet/sizes returns 3 sizes with correct pricing
GET /api/bouquet/flowers returns 11 flowers for builder
POST /api/bouquet/save with step-based data (size, flowers, pet_type, add_pet_toy) works correctly
POST /api/referral/validate properly validates referral codes (404 for invalid)
POST /api/orders/checkout accepts delivery_date and referral_code parameters
PUT /api/admin/orders/{id}/status endpoint requires authentication
GET /api/admin/orders/subscriptions endpoint requires authentication
Blog posts have SEO meta tags (meta_description and meta_keywords)
Homepage loads with Ole & Steen inspired full-width hero image and single CTA
Feature sections for pet-safe flowers, subscriptions, bouquet builder present
Shop page loads with category filters including Letterbox filter working
Product search input functionality working in shop page
Subscription page displays 3 monthly plans with pet toy toggle switches
Bouquet builder 4-step process: size selection → flower selection → pet type → review/add-ons
Bouquet builder shows safety notice and pet toy add-on option
Cart page has delivery date picker calendar component
Cart page has referral code input and validation
Navigation includes Account link that shows login for unauthenticated users
Admin dashboard properly redirects unauthenticated users to login page
Blog pages have SEO meta tags structure in place
Referral page handles invalid referral codes correctly

success_percentage.backend: 100% - All 19 API endpoints working correctly including new features
success_percentage.frontend: 95% - All pages loading and functioning properly with minor loading delay on subscriptions
